I hain’t been a-near your room since Miss Mary Jane took you and the duke and showed it to you.”", "sha256": "55920c037c87f9af71a394c122ec28ccff60f62a11cc081504f8c8516f6909ea", "source_location": "div.chapter[32]/*[25]", "source_html": "“Honor bright, your majesty, I’m telling you the truth. I hain’t been a-near your room since Miss Mary Jane took you and the duke and showed it to you.”"}, {"id": "043-030-0026", "tag": "p", "text": "The duke says:", "sha256": "f73b60875cb403dd9b1ef8480bb5cf6cc412292619ab17fb9ca56e62bb21653f", "source_location": "div.chapter[32]/*[26]", "source_html": "The duke says:"}, {"id": "043-030-0027", "tag": "p", "text": "“Have you seen anybody else go in there?”", "sha256": "6c01c4ca0f3bb65f34285a93012ce06cd78b63f3259083d9e0d732d19ca6a4e7", "source_location": "div.chapter[32]/*[27]", "source_html": "“Have you seen anybody else go in there?”"}, {"id": "043-030-0028", "tag": "p", "text": "“No, your grace, not as I remember, I believe.”", "sha256": "294eeba0e5bdb8918dc4f9fed2222a452a581fd23449de1ae08adb34ad3ad149", "source_location": "div.chapter[32]/*[28]", "source_html": "“No, your grace, not as I remember, I believe.”"}, {"id": "043-030-0029", "tag": "p", "text": "“Stop and think.”", "sha256": "fd6b91ea25ef9b16f751820c3c8e8a6e1a8f0572095fc86e6c410d3ae1c291e4", "source_location": "div.chapter[32]/*[29]", "source_html": "“Stop and think.”"}, {"id": "043-030-0030", "tag": "p", "text": "I studied awhile and see my chance; then I says:", "sha256": "db9fe10cb76379d5026d8dcd8d561c2cd19f67e8a5c083fd7419d8954f5104b0", "source_location": "div.chapter[32]/*[30]", "source_html": "I studied awhile and see my chance; then I says:"}, {"id": "043-030-0031", "tag": "p", "text": "“Well, I see the niggers go in there several times.”", "sha256": "f5b3cbea266f5c5b9c59ae8351159a536e298f04e71498aa46a1c4f9697d38a3", "source_location": "div.chapter[32]/*[31]", "source_html": "“Well, I see the niggers go in there several times.”"}, {"id": "043-030-0032", "tag": "p", "text": "Both of them gave a little jump, and looked like they hadn’t ever expected it, and then like they had. Then the duke says:", "sha256": "0e8dc97275f33e04c5089fab07e5a0eb2239f62d524cc4a51a51b89360623cd2", "source_location": "div.chapter[32]/*[32]", "source_html": "Both of them gave a little jump, and looked like they hadn’t ever expected it, and then like they had. Then the duke says:"}, {"id": "043-030-0033", "tag": "p", "text": "“What, all of them?”", "sha256": "92466c446db5371844d079860879901f7a95fb279cb00ae6621208f0d11dc918", "source_location": "div.chapter[32]/*[33]", "source_html": "“What, all of them?”"}, {"id": "043-030-0034", "tag": "p", "text": "“No—leastways, not all at once—that is, I don’t think I ever see them all come out at once but just one time.”", "sha256": "7d990f53bb54f09397027b81cd7c4eb5d2bb2a1e7d2fdebabb0833a723b2ead6", "source_location": "div.chapter[32]/*[34]", "source_html": "“No—leastways, not all at once—that is, I don’t think I ever see them all come out at once but just one time.”"}, {"id": "043-030-0035", "tag": "p", "text": "“Hello!
